programme.title: Cryptoland
programme.sub-title: Ransomware Is Everywhere. Can It Be Stopped?
programme.desc: All over the world criminals are locking up important computer systems and demanding crypto as a ransom. So-called ransomware is officially an epidemic, and cryptocurrencies sit at the nexus of the crisis. In this episode of Cryptoland, we sift through the fallout of a ransomware attack at schools in Afton, Missouri, and our panellists discuss the history and current role of crypto in this booming type of cyber-crime.

programme.title: Cryptoland
programme.sub-title: How Bitcoin Mines Were Airlifted From China To The Us
programme.desc: The Chinese government has long tried to stamp out cryptocurrencies in the country with varying levels of success. In 2021, a ban on mining finally sent firms packing and seeking countries like Kazakhstan with friendlier stances toward crypto mining. They've also found homes in towns all over the US, where companies are encountering both support and criticism from locals, as well as politicians at the state and federal levels.

programme.title: Cryptoland
programme.sub-title: Liberland: The Libertarian Crypto Micronation In Eastern Europe
programme.desc: All over the world, the crypto-wealthy are looking to create blockchain utopias that critics say are just the latest example of colonialism. In this episode of Cryptoland, we take you to 'Floating Man', a wild multi-day festival for believers in Liberland, a Bitcoin-powered micronation located in a contested patch of land between Croatia and Serbia that technically doesn't exist.

programme.title: Deepfake Porn: Could You Be Next?
programme.desc: Deepfake technology is giving rise to a new form of image based sexual abuse, where harmless images are turned into hardcore porn and used against victims. Most people think of deepfakes as manipulated video clips of world leaders designed to create confusion, but the most pressing threat of deepfakes is not politics, but porn.

Michael hears from its president how the three chambers of the legislature work and admires the twelfth-century Sword of State.

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: From the Isle of Man, Michael Portillo crosses the Irish Sea bound for the mighty port of Liverpool and its historic waterfront. Deep underground, Michael discovers one of the most important and secret rooms of the war - the Royal Navy's Western Approaches Headquarters, from where the Battle of the Atlantic was monitored and controlled.

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues his rail journey taking in the Isle of Man and the north-west coast of England. From Morecambe he looks out across the vast and beautiful Morecambe Bay, alive with cockles and brown shrimp. The Bay is famous for its potted shrimp and Michael joins one of the town's last shrimpers to learn how it's made.

programme.title: Cryptoland
programme.sub-title: Ransomware Is Everywhere. Can It Be Stopped?
programme.desc: All over the world criminals are locking up important computer systems and demanding crypto as a ransom. So-called ransomware is officially an epidemic, and cryptocurrencies sit at the nexus of the crisis. In this episode of Cryptoland, we sift through the fallout of a ransomware attack at schools in Afton, Missouri, and our panellists discuss the history and current role of crypto in this booming type of cyber-crime.

programme.title: Cryptoland
programme.sub-title: How Bitcoin Mines Were Airlifted From China To The Us
programme.desc: The Chinese government has long tried to stamp out cryptocurrencies in the country with varying levels of success. In 2021, a ban on mining finally sent firms packing and seeking countries like Kazakhstan with friendlier stances toward crypto mining. They've also found homes in towns all over the US, where companies are encountering both support and criticism from locals, as well as politicians at the state and federal levels.

programme.title: Cryptoland
programme.sub-title: Liberland: The Libertarian Crypto Micronation In Eastern Europe
programme.desc: All over the world, the crypto-wealthy are looking to create blockchain utopias that critics say are just the latest example of colonialism. In this episode of Cryptoland, we take you to 'Floating Man', a wild multi-day festival for believers in Liberland, a Bitcoin-powered micronation located in a contested patch of land between Croatia and Serbia that technically doesn't exist.

programme.title: Deepfake Porn: Could You Be Next?
programme.desc: Deepfake technology is giving rise to a new form of image based sexual abuse, where harmless images are turned into hardcore porn and used against victims. Most people think of deepfakes as manipulated video clips of world leaders designed to create confusion, but the most pressing threat of deepfakes is not politics, but porn.
